subject: R7 pilot economics instrumentation specification and event schema ready
body: R7 follow-on work is ready for review. The current beta has useful workflow boundaries but lacks the instrumentation required to measure cost per confirmed booking, straight-through automation, human support burden, exception/reconciliation cost, or economics by provider system/channel. I mapped an append-only privacy-minimized event model onto current app.py/workflow.py boundaries, defined explicit funnel denominators, channel/system dimensions, human-time categories, reason codes, cost attribution rules, KPI formulas, dashboard requirements, and regression tests preventing sensitive identifiers from entering economics telemetry. A draft JSON Schema is included so Primary/R10 can evaluate machine-readable implementation directly. Critical denominator rule: READY_FOR_TRANSACTION_ADAPTER, appointment request, waitlist, and hosted handoff must never increment confirmed-booking metrics; only authoritative confirmation may do so. Recommendation: instrument raw activity/time events before building profitability or automation dashboards, and keep labour-rate scenarios separate from immutable telemetry.
